neuralcanvas: Stays on your machine. No network, no account.
vectorstudio: Stays on your machine. No network requests, no account.
nodaysrammar: Your text is checked on your device and never sent to a server. Preferences use Chrome Sync.
ai-rules-builder: Runs in your browser. Saved configs stay in localStorage, and share links carry the config in the URL. No account, no tracking.
f1-telemetry-pro: Runs in your browser and fetches public race data from OpenF1. No account, no tracking.
browser-linux: History and cookies stay local, with no application telemetry. The optional page assistant sends page data to TypeSafe Jev or Claude only when you click.
sonora: Your library stays local, with no account or telemetry. Spotify, YouTube Music and LRCLIB connect directly from your machine.
cascade: Your idea goes to TypeSafe Jev and DeepSeek using your own keys, which stay in memory. No account, no telemetry. The rest runs locally.
whisperbar: Your voice goes to Deepgram or OpenRouter, and refinement text to OpenRouter, using your own keys in the macOS Keychain. Transcript history stays local.
kurek: Cloud-based, using your own keys. Voice goes to OpenRouter by default, requests to DeepSeek, spoken replies to xAI and screen captures to Gemini. Speech-to-text can fall back to local.
levele: Designs stay in your browser, and accounts are optional and local. No analytics or tracking. Live sessions are opt-in and send encrypted edits through a public relay.
